description.content: The following services are part of the Logistics APIs. Refer to [this section](/developer-guide/v3/integration-guide/dropship-only/logistics-api/overview-create-order) for more information.

Returns detailed information about bulkshipment or dropshipment orders.

*This service is part of Withings Pro Solutions. You won't be able to use it if you did not sign a contract with Withings.*
